what: Proposed validator uses raw exit and drops PUBLISH_OK contract
scenario_or_breakage: Invalid but existing design tmpdir exits 2 with no KEY=value stdout, while callers parse PUBLISH_OK and the script contract reserves non-zero for unexpected shell failures
suggested_fix: Preserve structured output: on validator failure emit PUBLISH_OK=false PR_NUMBER= PR_URL= and exit 0

scenario_or_breakage: Invalid design tmpdir exits 2 with only stderr instead of PAUSE_OK=false ERROR=tmpdir-invalid, breaking pause callers that parse KV stdout
suggested_fix: Use larch_design_tmpdir_validate "$DESIGN_TMPDIR" || emit_fail "tmpdir-invalid" after the existing unset/directory checks

what: Proposed validator turns a warning-only preview path into a hard failure
scenario_or_breakage: Gate C currently promises DESIGN_TMPDIR missing or invalid prints the warning and continues to the approval prompt; exit 2 can interrupt approval before any prompt
suggested_fix: Render the existing step3/gatec invalid DESIGN_TMPDIR warning and exit 0 on validator failure, before reading plan.txt

what: Proposed validator placement changes existing relative-path validation contract
scenario_or_breakage: Placing validation immediately after required args makes --design-tmpdir relative fail with the validator diagnostic/exit instead of the pinned must be an absolute path error in test-write-design-current-env
suggested_fix: Keep the existing absolute-path check before larch_design_tmpdir_validate, then validate the absolute DESIGN_TMPDIR_ARG before writing outputs
